comment:
*
 * Logic for parsing a text message typed by the user looking for smileys,
 * urls, acronyms,formatting (e.g., '*'s for bold), me commands
 * (e.g., "/me is asleep"), and punctuation.
 *
 * It constructs an array, which breaks the text up into its
 * constituent pieces, which we return to the client.
 *

variables.name: musicNote
variables.comment: Music note that indicates user is listening to a music track.

methods.name: protected abstract Resources getResources()
methods.comment:
* Subclasses must define the schemes, domains, smileys and acronyms
   * that are necessary for parsing

methods.name: public final String getRawText()
methods.comment: Returns the raw text being parsed.

methods.name: public final int getPartCount()
methods.comment: Return the number of parts.

methods.name: public final Part getPart(int index)
methods.comment: Return the part at the given index.

methods.name: public final List<Part> getParts()
methods.comment: Return the list of parts from the parsed text

methods.name: public void parse()
methods.comment: Parses the text string into an internal representation.

methods.name: public static Token tokenForUrl(String url, String text)
methods.comment:
* Get a the appropriate Token for a given URL
   *
   * @param text the anchor text
   * @param url the url
   *

methods.name: private void buildParts(String meText)
methods.comment:
* Builds the parts list.
   *
   * @param meText any meText parsed from the message

methods.name: private Part lastPart()
methods.comment: Returns the last part in the list.

methods.name: private boolean parseMusicTrack()
methods.comment:
* Looks for a music track (\u266B is first character, everything else is
   * track info).

methods.name: private void parseText()
methods.comment: Consumes all of the text in the next word .

methods.name: private boolean parseSmiley()
methods.comment:
* Looks for smileys (e.g., ":)") in the text.  The set of known smileys is
   * loaded from a file into a trie at server start.

methods.name: private boolean parseAcronym()
methods.comment: Looks for acronyms (e.g., "lol") in the text.

methods.name: private boolean isDomainChar(char c)
methods.comment: Determines if this is an allowable domain character.

methods.name: private boolean isValidDomain(String domain)
methods.comment: Determines if the given string is a valid domain.

methods.name: private boolean parseURL()
methods.comment:
* Looks for a URL in two possible forms:  either a proper URL with a known
   * scheme or a domain name optionally followed by a path, query, or query.

methods.name: private void addURLToken(String url, String text)
methods.comment:
* Adds the appropriate token for the given URL.  This might be a simple
   * link or it might be a recognized media type.

methods.name: private boolean parseFormatting()
methods.comment: * Deal with formatting characters. * * Parsing is as follows: * - Treat all contiguous strings of formatting characters as one block. * (This method processes one block.) * - Only a single instance of a particular format character within a block * is used to determine whether to turn on/off that type of formatting; * other instances simply print the character itself. * - If the format is to be turned on, we use the _first_ instance; if it * is to be turned off, we use the _last_ instance (by appending the * format.) * * Example: * **string** turns into *string*

methods.name: private boolean isWordBreak(int index)
methods.comment: Determines whether the given index could be a possible word break.

methods.name: private boolean isSmileyBreak(int index)
methods.comment: Determines whether the given index could be a possible smiley break.

methods.name: private boolean isURLBreak(int index)
methods.comment:
* Verifies that the character before the given index is end of line,
   * whitespace, or punctuation.

methods.name: private int getCharClass(int index)
methods.comment: Returns the class for the character at the given index.

methods.name: private static boolean isSmileyBreak(char c1, char c2)
methods.comment: * Returns true if c1 could be the last character of * a smiley and c2 could be the first character of * a different smiley, if {@link #isWordBreak} would not already * recognize that this is possible.

methods.name: private static boolean isPunctuation(char ch)
methods.comment: Determines whether the given character is punctuation.

methods.name: private static boolean isFormatChar(char ch)
methods.comment:
* Determines whether the given character is the beginning or end of a
   * section with special formatting.

methods.name: private void addToken(Token token)
methods.comment: Adds the given token to the parsed output.

methods.name: public String toHtml()
methods.comment: Converts the entire message into a single HTML display string.

methods.name: protected static String reverse(String str)
methods.comment: Returns the reverse of the given string.

methods.name: private static boolean matches(TrieNode root, String str)
methods.comment: Determines whether the given string is in the given trie.

methods.name: private static TrieNode longestMatch(TrieNode root, AbstractMessageParser p, int start)
methods.comment:
* Returns the longest substring of the given string, starting at the given
   * index, that exists in the trie.

methods.name: private static TrieNode longestMatch(TrieNode root, AbstractMessageParser p, int start, boolean smiley)
methods.comment:
* Returns the longest substring of the given string, starting at the given
   * index, that exists in the trie, with a special tokenizing case for
   * smileys if specified.
